Reviving [[Ride My Rocket|the old tournament]] that {{player|Madmax|flag=se}} and {{player|Empezar|flag=se}} did back in 2002, and moving forward with the legendary name.  Now hosting one-map duel and 2on2 tournaments.

===Format===
* Groupstage 4-6 teams each group. The top 3 teams go to Groupstage 2A, and the rest to Groupstage 2B.  Playoffs after that.
* 10 min matches with 3 min overtime
* All rounds are {{abbr|BO5|Best of 5}}, pick pick pick pick toss toss
* Teams consist of 2-4 players max
